answer: Each agent identity mints only by burning a proof-of-work attestation: the kth identity requires hashing power equal to 0.5·k² GPU-hours (quadratic cost), so 10 fake "pearl" agents cost 50 GPU-hours while 100 cost 5000. A verifier "prism" node samples each identity's attestation; if its latency "plume" fingerprint shows the same hardware signature across identities, all linked identities' burned work is invalidated, making clone farms prohibitively expensive.
